description: This file defines an API route in a FastAPI application for orchestrating multi-agent solutions. It handles POST requests to trigger orchestration tasks, involving session retrieval, calling an orchestrator service, and returning structured responses including message and step details.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message exchanged between the system and users, includes metadata, timestamp, sender, session ID, and content.

classes.name: OrchestrateResponse
classes.description: Response model encapsulating the result message, involved agents, and orchestration steps.

methods.name: orchestrate(payload: OrchestrateRequest)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that handles POST requests to orchestrate multi-agent tasks, manages session lookup, calls the orchestrator, and returns the orchestration result.
